vulnerability_analysis: The LineAxis token contract has a mint function that is only callable by the owner. The ownership transfer mechanism allows the current owner to nominate a new owner, who can then confirm the transfer. An attacker can exploit this by first impersonating the current owner to nominate themselves, then confirming ownership, and finally minting unlimited tokens to themselves.
attack_strategy: 1. Use vm.prank to impersonate the current owner and call transferOwner(attacker). 2. As the attacker, call confirmOwner() to become the new owner. 3. Call mint(attacker, largeAmount) to create tokens for ourselves.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner address by calling owner() function. 2. Impersonate the owner using vm.prank. 3. Call transferOwner(attacker) to nominate ourselves as new owner. 4. Call confirmOwner() as attacker to complete ownership transfer. 5. Call mint(attacker, 1_000_000 * 1e18) to mint tokens. 6. Verify attacker's balance increased.
